CustomField.description: When ticked and the org has plenty of headroom, the chat window is told a reply is ready by a platform event. When not ticked, or when the org nears a limit, the chat window polls instead, which uses no event allowance.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Use platform events to tell the chat window a reply is ready. Off: the window polls. Events switch themselves off near an org limit.
CustomField.label: Is Event Notification Enabled
